name: SG90 micro servo
summary: The 9 g blue hobby servo. Mounting tabs 28 mm apart, 2 mm holes.
source: SG90 is a clone family with no single official drawing and real variation between sellers. Values here are the commonly published ones: 32.2 x 12.2 mm overall including tabs, 22.8 mm body, tab holes about 28 mm apart. The part is modelled flange-up, with the body hanging below as a keepout. Measure yours before cutting the mounting slot.

electrical.note: Stall current is far above the running current. Do not power it from a board's 5 V pin.
